Argonne National Labs- Fuel System Configuration and Design: Argonne National Laboratory (ANL) conducted a systems analysis to define the configuration and balance‑of‑plant for liquid hydrogen storage tanks suitable for Class 8 fuel cell trucks. Figure 26 shows a fuel system configuration from this work. As a preliminary step, two Type‑5 carbon fiber composite (CFC) tank concepts were evaluated: an elliptical tank and a multi‑lobe conformable tank (fLH ‑2). Both concepts provide 2 the same internal storage volume usable for vehicle operation under the modeled duty cycle. The analysis found that the elliptical configuration is more compact and offers higher gravimetric and volumetric capacity than the multi‑lobe conformable design. However, an elliptical geometry is structurally less efficient in sustaining internal pressure, and this configuration was not analyzed for its structural capability and thermal Page 25 of 30 Approved for Public Release stresses, which was to be the next step. RTX has evolved its tank design to a new conformal design, which needs to be subject to the above analysis- also not performed due to program termination. The fuel system design, analysis and findings were captured in a detailed report that was submitted to DOE at the end of Q4, 2024 [8]. Figure 26.
